Description: NexCort iQ Feature Modules (13 competitive differentiators). Tables use rapid-cortex-{name}-{DeploymentStage}. Evidence bucket enables S3 Object Lock (GOVERNANCE, 5-year default) at CREATE TIME ONLY — Object Lock cannot be added to an existing bucket. Lambdas: FeaturesHttpFunction catch-all, learning-nightly, checkin-expiry, Bluesky poll (2 min), Ring Neighbors + Nextdoor webhook receivers, DLQ review worker (rate 5 minutes).

WebUrl.Description: Origin allowed for PrePlan/Evidence S3 CORS PUT. Empty → "*".

BedrockModelArn.Description: Optional Bedrock model/inference-profile ARN for learning/assessment. Empty omits the Bedrock IAM statement (statement-level !If — never NoValue in Resource lists).

ActiveAgencyIds.Description: Comma-separated agency IDs for scheduled feature workers (check-in expiry, Bluesky poll, learning). Empty → workers no-op until set.

SocialAgencyConfigs.Description: Optional JSON array of {agencyId,cityHints,lat,lon,radiusKm,blueskyEnabled} for social jurisdiction filtering. Prefer Secrets Manager for large configs.

RingNeighborsWebhookSecretArn.Description: Secrets Manager ARN for Ring Neighbors webhook HMAC secret (rapid-cortex/social/ring-neighbors-webhook-secret*). Empty → Ring Lambda returns 503 until configured (statement-level !If — never NoValue in Resource).

WebSocketConnectionsTable.Description: Connections table for CHECKIN_EXPIRED agency broadcast. Empty → soft no-op.

WebSocketApiId.Description: API Gateway WebSocket API id for execute-api:ManageConnections IAM.

AgencyKMSKeyArn.Description: Optional customer-managed KMS key ARN for Features DynamoDB tables and S3 buckets. Empty → AWS-managed AES256. When set, SSE uses KMS + this key.

SIEMEnabled.Description: When true (and SIEMEndpointUrl is set), provisions a Firehose HTTP delivery stream + S3 backup bucket for SIEM log export. Default off.

SIEMEndpointUrl.Description: HTTPS URL of the customer SIEM HTTP collector. Required when SIEMEnabled=true. Empty disables SIEM resources even if SIEMEnabled is true.
